messages:
Maria (Partnerships): ok team — we need a concrete plan for the partner SDK/ API change next month. partners want a 6-week heads up, but engineering prefers a staggered ramp. proposing a 'rolling pin' approach: small set of partners -> marketplace vendors -> broader SDK consumers. thoughts?
Sam (Eng): rolling pin sounds good. main constraints: binary shims take ~2w per vendor to validate, marketplace approvals add uncertainty. need clear semver rule and a compatibility gate.
Jess (DevRel): +1. we should publish a compatibility matrix and a short migration guide (1 pager) per partner bucket. can handle comms cadence if we have the exact dates. :calendar:
Arun (Product): high level: keep breaking change to minimal surface (auth header rename + one optional field). offer opt-in flag for 8 weeks, then auto-enforce with a header check. partners that opt-in get extended support.
Kai (Infra): one infra note — Dedicated customers on older agent images will need a shim. we can add a runtime toggle, but rollout needs infra deploy windows. ci-bot: deploy window calendar shows 2 maintenance slots/week.
Maria (Partnerships): ok so concrete milestones: 1) announce deprecation + migration docs (T+0) 2) enable opt-in flag (T+2w) 3) start partner canaries (selected vendors) (T+4w) 4) marketplace vendor validation (T+5-7w) 5) enforce (T+10w). is that too aggressive?
Sam (Eng): T+10w might be tight because of marketplace lag. propose: enforce at T+12w and keep opt-in flag until T+14w for Dedicated + Private customers. that gives time for shims and agent updates.
Jess (DevRel): can we add a beta SDK release (patch) that logs a deprecation warning and auto-translates the old header? sample: ```js
// shim client example
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey, legacyAuth: true })
```
That helps partners buy time.
Arun (Product): good. also need a partner-facing checklist: SDK version, marketplace package id, contact, SLA for roll, and a failure rollback plan. I'll draft.
Maria (Partnerships): partner outreach plan: email + doc link + scheduled 1:1 for top 10 partners. marketplace vendors get a separate thread with validation steps. document to include test matrix and curl examples.
Kai (Infra): test matrix note: include token expiry scenarios and switching from header A->B. infra will provide a canary cluster for vendor validation (request sent).
Sam (Eng): integration tests we want: compatibility smoke, KV cache behavior, streaming fallback. I'll add a github checklist and a github action that runs partner smoke tests on PRs. ci-bot: created issue template: https://git.redwood/infra/compatibility-checklist (mock link)
Jess (DevRel): comms: 3 emails: announce, 4w reminder, enforcement notice. also blog post for public docs and release notes. I'll own templates.
Maria (Partnerships): escalation path? partners often ping partnerships slack after breaking bits. propose an SLA: 24h response for top partners, 72h for others, with a hotfix rotation.
Arun (Product): add a rollback toggle in the control plane so we can flip back to old behavior per partner if needed. entitlements team to confirm gating.
Sam (Eng): final ask: a compatibility matrix CSV that lists partner, SDKs affected, required shim code, test status, and a go/no-go column. we should track in the partner tracker spreadsheet.
Maria (Partnerships): i'll assemble the matrix template and start outreach tomorrow. can everyone drop their 'must-haves' into the matrix by EOD Friday?
Jess (DevRel): dropping notes now.
Kai (Infra): will add canary cluster ETA and agent image notes.
Sam (Eng): I'll prep the semver policy blurb and the opt-in flag implementation details.
Maria (Partnerships): awesome — next sync in this thread Friday 10am PT. if blockers pop up ping me @Maria. :thumbsup:
